node.title: Re: Perl Memory problem ...
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: That's not much information to go on, and nowadays, 30MB isn't that much at all. Perhaps you could show some code to reproduce the issue ([id://1177642|SSCCE], [id://174051]), and explain what the problem is? Like for example, if the memory use continually goes up, that would indicate a memory leak.
